Here's where Modal fits. Grok searches X through the ex A I API. It looks at posts from a few public accounts. Everything after that runs on Modal, right up to the page anyone can open.
0001b.png

Why use Modal? The job comes in bursts: one big parallel search, then nothing until the next check. A laptop script stops when the lid closes, and a server of your own sits idle all day. On Modal, a schedule runs the re-checks with no server to maintain. Map spreads the xAI calls across many containers at once. A Dict stores the results, and a web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. The xAI key lives in a Modal Secret. When nothing is running, the app scales to zero, so you pay per second of work.

A Dict stores the results, and a web endpoint serves the page at a public URL. The xAI key lives in a Modal Secret. When nothing is running, the app scales to zero, so you pay per second of work.
